name: Ane Tsumami 2 ~Ecchi na Onee-san Hitozuma ni Tappuri Amaeru Mecha Shiko Love Life~
original_name: あねつまみ2 ～エッチなお姉さん人妻にたっぷり甘えるめちゃシコLoveLife～
source:
The protagonist, Kizuka Daiya, is a student who lives with his parents. One day, his parents leave for a business trip abroad, leaving him to stay home alone due to his school

Worried for the protagonist, two young married ladies decide to take care of him.
He gets to be pampered by the women he adores and been close with since his childhood, his neighbour Nanasawa Aoi and his relative Tachibana Mahiru.
The sex life where he gets a little bit naughty and affectionate begins!

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc082/introduction.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公木冢大哉是一名与父母住在一起的学生。有一天，父母出差，他因学业而独自在家。

两位年轻的已婚女士担心主角，决定照顾他。
他受到了他从小就崇拜并亲近的女性——邻居七泽葵和亲戚橘真昼的宠爱。
有点调皮又有点深情的性生活开始了！

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc082/introduction.html]官网[/url]]
